native_measurements: All builds and initial tests completed before native measurement; no build, test or other benchmark overlapped any native round.
callgrind_measurements: Instruction counting overlaps the added CTE/derived-input test build, SQL checks and selected lint. These checks began after every native phase completed. No other benchmark overlaps Callgrind.
saved_measurement_binaries: The checks change test data only. Engine and benchmark source hashes remain those in source.json.
initial_isolation_record: isolation.json describes the state before measurement and the script-controlled sequence; this record accounts for the subsequent checks.
